keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
First Half ends, Excelsior 0, Go Ahead Eagles 0.
Second Half begins Excelsior 0, Go Ahead Eagles 0.
Delay in match (Go Ahead Eagles).
Delay in match (Excelsior).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Victor Edvardsen replaces Thibo Baeten.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Erik Flataker replaces Stefán Sigurdarson.
Substitution, Excelsior. David Garden replaces Mario Domínguez.
Substitution, Excelsior. Valentin Sulzbacher replaces Noah Naujoks.
Substitution, Excelsior. Alireza Jahanbakhsh replaces Aymen Sliti.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Go Ahead Eagles 1. Søren Tengstedt (Go Ahead Eagles) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mathis Suray.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Oskar Sivertsen replaces Søren Tengstedt.
Substitution, Excelsior. Simon Janssen replaces Kasey Bos.
Substitution, Excelsior. Yacqub Finey replaces Ágúst Thorsteinsson.
Tomas Galvez (Go Ahead Eagles) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Gerrit Nauber replaces Alfons Sampsted.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Tino Jukic replaces Yassir Salah Rahmouni.
Delay in match because of an injury Julius Dirksen (Go Ahead Eagles).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
